title: Discipline team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/discipline.yaml: the team layer of the discipline plugin's settings. A value here overrides the same key in the plugin's userConfig. Keys and resolution: plugins/discipline/reference/config.md. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

written_against.description: The plugin version the setup writer last wrote this file against, as <plugin>@<version>. The writer owns it; it is not a setting.

provenance.description: Per setting, whether the team chose the value or it was filled at the plugin default. The writer owns it; it is not a setting.

lever_scope.description: When /discipline:script-the-deterministic-work lever-check answers build-a-lever for a change repeated across many sites. deterministic: only when the change is a mechanical transformation. non-trivial: for any non-trivial repeated change, built with an established codemod tool rather than a hand-written refactoring script.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example do-your-research); an entry beats this file's verification value.
